Title: Fear of Mekhet & Illusions of Kindred Qn

Messages.Author: Andrew Loder
Messages.Body:
With Illusions of the kindred, if I use it to bring out a vamp from the
crypt can I use it again (assuming the pulled vamp has chi/CHI) to pull
out another vamp and if so what happens to the first pulled vamp (still
gets removed from the game right?)

Fear of Mekhet. I realise this has probably been gone over a hundred
times but when it comes into play you can target a justicar or inner
circle member. When it changes vamps it can only target inner circle
members. I take it that no errata has been made on it (couldnt find
any). It just seems odd that you can initially target an a justicar and
then are restricted from later.

Cheers,

Andrew

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Loder wrote:
>
> With Illusions of the kindred, if I use it to bring out a vamp from the
> crypt can I use it again (assuming the pulled vamp has chi/CHI) to pull
> out another vamp and if so what happens to the first pulled vamp (still
> gets removed from the game right?)

You can use another Illusions in the second combat, yes.
The first illusionary vampire will be removed when his combat ends, yes.

> Fear of Mekhet. I realise this has probably been gone over a hundred
> times but when it comes into play you can target a justicar or inner
> circle member. When it changes vamps it can only target inner circle
> members. I take it that no errata has been made on it (couldnt find
> any). It just seems odd that you can initially target an a justicar and
> then are restricted from later.

2) Once Fear of Mekhet is in play, it may only be moved to Inner Circle
members. This is deliberate.

[RTR 24 Jan 1996]
